helpDeal: d                        deal one card onto every column
helpMoveTF: m t <col> f              tableau to a foundation
helpMoveTT: m t <from> t <to> [idx]  tableau to tableau (idx = head of the run, default top)
helpWaive: wv <col> [idx]           waive a run aside (only once the stock is gone)
helpMoveWT: m w t <col>              put the waived cards back on a column
helpMoveWF: m w f                    send a single waived card to a foundation
waivedLine: Waived: {{cards}} (no dealing until they are back)
undoToEscape: Undo {{count}} move(s) to escape the dead end (undo {{count}}, or repeat u)
helpExampleAuto: ac                       send everything that can go to a foundation
errReturnWaivedFirst: Return the waived cards before dealing
errBadFromColumn: That source column does not exist
errBadToColumn: That destination column does not exist
errSameColumn: Source and destination are the same column
errNotDescendingRun: Those cards are not an alternating-colour descending run
errCannotPlaceTableau: That card cannot go on the tableau there
errCannotPlaceFoundation: That card cannot go on the foundation
errWaiveNeedsEmptyStock: You can only waive once the stock is exhausted
errCannotPlaceWaived: The waived cards cannot go there
errWaivedSingleOnly: Only a single waived card can go to a foundation
errNotPlaying: The game is not in the playing phase
